# v0.1.0 — Initial release

2026-09-08 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.1.0)

## Changes

Key-based table comparison, column mappings, composite keys, validation errors and CSV export.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.1.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../comparison) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
